In this video, Karthik Rangappa reflects on the extreme volatility seen in 2026 and what it revealed about real-world trading. As markets behaved unpredictably and traditional assumptions broke down, this episode explores the deeper lessons that only such phases can teach. If you’ve ever relied on textbook strategies or felt caught off guard in fast-moving markets, this perspective will make you rethink how you approach risk.
